title: CollectAI data models
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for every persisted entity. Field names match specs/design/api-contracts.md. Synthetic data only. The top-level object describes a whole dataset (table name to array of rows) so seed files can be validated with it.

Money.description: Decimal string with exactly 2 decimal places, stored as NUMERIC(14,2). Never a float.

band_cutoffs.description: Strictly ascending, each within 0 and the sum of the weights (cross-field rule checked by the loader)

Customer.description: A synthetic bank customer. The vulnerability flag is set by a VULNERABLE_CUSTOMER case and released only by a human decision.

vulnerability_category.description: Non-null iff vulnerability_flag; must be in policy vulnerability.categories

vulnerability_case_id.description: Case that set the flag (FK escalation_case)

Account.description: A CARD or PERSONAL_LOAN account. Shared abstraction with product-specific attributes in product_attributes (D-014).

product_attributes.description: CARD: credit_limit, minimum_payment_due. PERSONAL_LOAN: original_principal, term_months, monthly_installment (money strings, term_months numeric string)

DelinquencyRecord.description: Current snapshot of delinquency facts for one account. Every update increments record_version and stamps as_of (E1-S3 AC7, E2-S5).

as_of.description: Snapshot time; null means freshness UNKNOWN

record_version.description: Monotonic, starts at 1, +1 on every update

DelinquentItem.description: An overdue component that can be disputed (installment, statement cycle, fee).

Interaction.description: A previous (synthetic) contact or system event on an account; feeds the recent-contact priority factor and contact-frequency policy.

PromiseToPay.description: A customer payment commitment. Lifecycle PENDING to KEPT, BROKEN or CANCELLED only (E6-S4).

item_id.description: Optional item the PTP is against (disputed-item check)

promised_date.description: Between today and today + ptp.window_days at creation

cumulative_paid.description: Qualifying successful simulated payments counted so far

PaymentEvent.description: A SIMULATED payment outcome. No real payment ever occurs (D-021). Immutable once written.

simulated.description: Always true; CHECK (simulated) rejects any non-simulated row

balance_after.description: Outstanding balance after the event (unchanged when FAILED)

PaymentArrangement.description: An installment arrangement with schedule (Slice 2). Created only through the arrangement domain service.

exception_case_id.description: Case that approved the exception; non-null iff EXCEPTION_APPROVAL

schedule.description: Full schedule; sums exactly to total_amount

HardshipCase.description: Structured hardship record created from a validated flag_hardship proposal (Slice 2). No relief is ever executed in the MVP.

Dispute.description: Structured dispute created from a validated flag_dispute proposal (Slice 3). The LLM never judges validity.

item_id.description: Disputed item; null means the whole overdue amount

EscalationCase.description: A human-review case. Queue, reviewer_role and priority are set ONLY by the routing service from the reason and the active PolicyRuleSet (D-030).

conversation_id.description: Linked conversation (null for reviewer re-routes without one)

recommendation_id.description: AI recommendation shown to the reviewer, when any

routing_flags.description: e.g. reason_unrecognized, POLICY_UNAVAILABLE; empty array normally

first_reviewed_at.description: First move out of OPEN; feeds the time-to-review KPI

ReviewDecision.description: A recorded human decision or state transition on an EscalationCase. Insert-only.

reason.description: Mandatory for REJECT, MODIFY, ESCALATE, APPROVE and compliance decisions

overrode_ai.description: REJECT or MODIFY on a case whose source is AI (human override rate)

Conversation.description: A customer chat conversation on one owned account.

account_id.description: FK account, must belong to the customer

clarification_count.description: Consecutive UNKNOWN clarifications issued (bounded by MAX_CLARIFICATION_TURNS)

ChatMessage.description: One message. Assistant text is grounded model text or a template.

turn_id.description: Turn that produced it (null for the greeting and confirmations)

ChatTurn.description: One request/response cycle. Stores the structured interpretation and links used for idempotent replay.

intent.description: Advisory interpretation; null when the provider failed

safe_state.description: NONE unless a fail-closed state applied

tool_call_count.description: Executed tool calls this turn, <= TOOL_CALL_CAP_PER_TURN

Proposal.description: A deterministic, customer-visible proposal awaiting explicit confirmation (D-041). Created by services, never by the LLM directly.

conversation_id.description: FK conversation (null for reviewer MODIFY proposals tied to a case)

terms.description: PtpTerms, PaymentTerms, ArrangementTerms or ExceptionRequestTerms (discriminated by kind)

terms_hash.description: sha256 of canonical terms; echoed by the confirm request

record_version.description: DelinquencyRecord version it is valid for

expires_at.description: After this Clock time the proposal is EXPIRED

resulting_resource_id.description: ptp_, pay_, arr_ or esc_ id created on confirmation

Recommendation.description: A stored AI next-best-action, always labelled AI-generated. May be a TEMPLATE-only fallback. Never changes financial state.

status.description: GENERATED, SAFE_FALLBACK or HUMAN_REVIEW_ONLY (AI_UNAVAILABLE and NOT_GENERATED are response states and are not stored)

AuditEvent.description: Immutable, append-only audit record, written in the same transaction as the state transition it describes. The application DB role has INSERT and SELECT only.

sequence.description: Monotonic identity column for stable ordering

ai_output.description: Redacted AI output; schema-invalid output is stored here too

token_usage.description: Tokens and estimated cost where available

PolicyRuleSet.description: Immutable, versioned rule set (specs/policy-ruleset-contract.md). Exactly one row is active. Older versions stay readable so any audit event resolves.

content_hash.description: sha256 of canonical parameters; detects tampering

DemoSession.description: Demo persona session (NOT authentication). For CUSTOMER it binds the token to one seeded customer_id server-side.

session_token_hash.description: PK, sha256 of the opaque token (the raw token is returned once and never stored)

customer_id.description: Bound customer; required iff persona = CUSTOMER

IdempotencyRecord.description: Stored result of an idempotent operation so replays return the original result (D-037).

scope.description: persona + bound customer or session + endpoint template

request_hash.description: sha256 of canonical request body; mismatch gives 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

response_status.description: HTTP status of the original response

ClockState.description: Singleton (id = 1) holding the simulated Clock when DEMO_CONTROLS_ENABLED. Absent or mode SYSTEM otherwise.

EvalRun.description: One evaluation run (MOCK or LIVE). MOCK and LIVE are never merged. Written by the evaluation package, read by the KPI service through the persistence layer.

intent_accuracy.description: Overall accuracy 0..1; never compared to targets for MOCK

metrics.description: Per-category TP, FN, recall, escalation precision and recall, structured-output compliance, grounding, safety-set results

triggered_by.description: CLI user or CI job name; LIVE is refused in CI

EvalCaseResult.description: Per-case result of an EvalRun. Internal; no API exposure in the MVP.

case_id.description: Case id inside the dataset file

expected.description: Expected intent, safety signals, escalation reason

critical_policy_violation.description: True for a missed vulnerable-customer escalation or any BRD 4.2 violation
